name: self-chrome
description: Lets a session make sure Chrome runs for Claude in Chrome: it looks for your Chrome, starts it when it isn't running (on the profile you name, else on the one profile whose Google account has the email of Claude Code's account; the last session restored; and --silent-debugger-extension-api when you opt in), and reconnects Claude in Chrome once the turn ends. It never quits or restarts Chrome.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

silentDebugger.title: Silent debugger flag
silentDebugger.description: Whether a Chrome this plugin starts gets --silent-debugger-extension-api, which hides Chrome's "is debugging this browser" banner for every extension and every profile in that Chrome. auto: only when the environment variable CLAUDE_CHROME_SILENT_DEBUGGER is 1, true or on. on: always. off: never. Chrome takes the flag only when it starts.

profile.title: Chrome profile
profile.description: A pin: the profile folder a Chrome this plugin starts opens, by its folder's name (Default, Profile 2); it must be one of Chrome's profile folders. Empty: the one profile folder whose Google account (in Chrome's Local State) has the email of Claude Code's Claude account (in its .claude.json), held against this session's own sign-in where Claude Code says it, else the file alone; with none or several, or an account that can't be read or confirmed, nothing starts. Set it where the two emails differ, or to start the profile Chrome used last.

chromePath.title: Chrome executable
chromePath.description: Chrome's executable, as an absolute path with no [, ] or backtick: chrome.exe on Windows, the Google Chrome binary inside its .app on macOS. Empty: the standard install paths.
